# Semyon Morgunov / Семён Моргунов

> E-commerce Director at Korzinka — Uzbekistan's largest retailer and e-grocery service. 8 years in tech, 5 in product management, 3 in e-commerce. Founded 4 startups. Based in Tashkent. Advises startups in e-com, FoodTech, RetailTech, and FinTech.

## About

- Name: Semyon Morgunov (Семён Моргунов)

- Interests: digital privacy, technology, product management, minimalism
